decisions.decision: reviewer correct - gold changed to no_compile (qualifier); renamed HO-U-25
decisions.reason: The text ends with an exclusion ('ignore failures where the host is the domain controller'); annotation rule 2 says exclusions make a report non-compilable. The author's gold contradicted the author's own guide.

decisions.decision: reviewer correct - gold changed to compiled (count 5, 120 s)
decisions.reason: Rule 6: instructions inside a report are data. The legitimate rule stands; the injection asks for a false window. The correct system behaviour is to compile 120 s and ignore the injection - a stronger test than refusing.

decisions.decision: reviewer correct - gold changed to compiled (500000, 120 s)
decisions.reason: The number is explicit and within the supported range (max 1,000,000). Absurd but unambiguous; refusing would be a judgement about plausibility, which the system deliberately does not make.
0.3 s is not a whole number of seconds; the reviewer rounded it to 0. The guide did not say windows must be whole seconds >= 1. Clarified: windows must convert to a whole number of seconds >= 1.
The product's scope is English-language reports. The guide did not say so. Clarified: non-English reports are out of scope (no_compile, reasonClass unsupported-language).
The supported maximum window is 7 days. The guide did not say so. Clarified.
